entries.text: The start screen says the game is still being built
The gold pile grows with the purse
Scurrius sheds rats 50% more often
Scurrius shares his rats' weakness to Air
Scurrius stops to squeak, and his rats obey a stun
Scurrius takes the swarm axis
Stop ordinary waves sending a boss's adds as trash
Bake Scurrius's animation clips from the cache
Leash a returning rat to Scurrius so the refund is visible
Scurrius sheds rats that wander the board and run his HP back
Keep balance numbers out of Scurrius's kill tip
Scurrius and his Giant rats join the roster
Scurrius shear maths — HP changes shape, never grows
Volatile now blows a hole in your board instead of blinking one tower
Brutus now charges at a tower instead of at empty ground
Brutus flattens the towers he charges through, and a downed tower now shows it
Brutus charges off the road, and the boss ladder now starts with him
The wave preview no longer grows into a wall you can't build under
The red that warns you is the bright one everywhere, not the maroon
Waves 10-19 stay a single boss, so a veteran run cannot open with a pile-up
Every boss now tells you how it is meant to be killed
Sort the custom-wave roster by name, bosses last
Vorkath's ice shield sounds like ice going up, not a melee thud
A boss only starts breaking free once you are actually fighting it
A leak now tells you what it cost, and an escaped Guardian stays gone
Dragging a panel's scrollbar now scrolls it instead of dragging the window
The Giant Mole digs less often and skips less road
A Regenerating boss loosens its grip the deeper the run goes
Bosses show the prayers they are protecting with
A boss's death cry is no longer cut off the instant it starts
Every boss now dies with its own voice
Moving a HUD panel aside now frees the board underneath — no ghost blocking tower placement
Extending a task twice no longer multiplies its reward without end
A stalled Regenerating boss's heal dries up so it can't tick-eat forever
Dragon Knife's card no longer reads the confusable "loose a second shot"
Cerberus's summoned souls fade on death instead of a broken upright swing
Rename Soul Stealer to Soul Eater and drop the redundant Soul Split card
A packed board with Clan Vexillum no longer tanks the frame rate
Auto-wave always starts off on a new or restored run
Close the bottom-bar panels by right-click, drop the X
